references.title: Lean-QIT: quantum information theory in Lean 4

relevant_declarations.name: QIT.State.relativeEntropy_dataProcessing_channel_ge
relevant_declarations.why: Data-processing inequality for quantum relative entropy -- the upstream discharge of this corpus's `hDPI` hypothesis.
relevant_declarations.statement: ∀ {a b} [Fintype a] [DecidableEq a] [Fintype b] [DecidableEq b] (rho sigma : State a) (Phi : Channel a b), rho.relativeEntropy sigma ≥ (Phi.applyState rho).relativeEntropy (Phi.applyState sigma)
relevant_declarations.note: STRONGER than this corpus needs: stated for an ARBITRARY channel, where `hDPI` requires only the partial-trace instance.

relevant_declarations.name: QIT.State.condMutualInfo_nonneg
relevant_declarations.why: Non-negativity of conditional mutual information, i.e. strong subadditivity.
relevant_declarations.statement: ∀ {a b c} [Fintype a] [DecidableEq a] [Fintype b] [DecidableEq b] [Fintype c] [DecidableEq c] (ρ : State ((a × b) × c)), 0 ≤ ρ.condMutualInfo

independent_verification.method: Cloned at the commit above, built standalone on its OWN toolchain (Lean v4.30.0), then `#print axioms` on both declarations via `lake env lean`.
independent_verification.result: Both build clean and depend on exactly the foundational triple [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound] -- the same footprint this corpus holds itself to. Repo-wide: 0 `axiom`, 0 `sorry` across 322 modules.
independent_verification.what_this_does_NOT_establish: That their `relativeEntropy` / `State` / `Channel` definitions agree with this corpus's `relEntropy` / `Matrix` + `PosSemidef` / `partialTraceRight` up to the intended correspondence. THAT is exactly the bridge's job and it has NOT been checked. The theorem is verified; the translation is not.

references.status: CITED, NOT IMPORTED. Lake resolves one version per dependency and the toolchains differ (Lean v4.30.0 / Mathlib tag v4.30.0 upstream, vs v4.33.0-rc1 / Mathlib master c732b96d here), so no dependency edge exists. This corpus's SSA therefore REMAINS CONDITIONAL on `hDPI`. The citation records where the wall is climbed; it does not climb it here.
references.planned_use: A separate `csd-qit-bridge` package depending on both projects BY TAG, holding the Matrix<->State adapter, discharging `hDPI`, and exporting unconditional SSA. Neither project merges into the other; CsdLean4 keeps its Mathlib-only dependency footprint.
